title: NouSR kit options: Cyrene (1415)
description: A scenario member's kit_options for Cyrene (docs/proposals/scenario-kit-options.md, DESIGN.md K26). Every option has a finite domain, so an optimizer can enumerate it from this file. Demiurge chooses only on the extra turns Cyrene's Ultimates give it; its Story and Trailblazer (Remembrance) extra turns are automatic.

items.description: A member key of the same team other than Cyrene's own: "This Ode, to All Lives" on that member (it cannot target Cyrene herself). "attack": Minuet of Blooms and Plumes.

demiurge_order.x-nousr-computed-default: Every other team member in party order, then "attack". A placeholder: a run that uses it carries the warning kit-option-default-used.

after_order.description: What Demiurge does on a choice turn after demiurge_order is used up: attack, repeat the last entry, or start the list again. A run that gets there carries the warning kit-option-list-exhausted.
